args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

round_money's docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round
to the nearest even cent, matching tests/test_money.py and FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary
- Fix FIN-212: `round_money` in `src/money.py` now uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (banker's rounding) instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- The docstring already claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212; now the implementation matches it.
- Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (`2.665` now rounds to `2.66` instead of `2.67`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed all tests.

## Release
- Needs to ship in today's release — requesting code-owner approval so it can be merged promptly.

transcript.reasoning_content: Interesting: 2.675 quantized to 0.01 with HALF_EVEN: 2.675 → last digit of 2.67 is 7, odd, so round half to even → 2.68. Yes. 2.665 → 2.66 (6 even). Fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN.
